bio.text: Andrew Collins, a Democrat, represents Arkansas House District 73, which runs from Riverdale to Pinnacle and covers much of north and west Little Rock; the House lists him as House Minority Leader in his fourth term.
He is an attorney who works in real estate for Cypress Properties.
Collins graduated from Duke University and Columbia Law School and then moved back to his hometown of Little Rock, where he lives with his wife and three children.
